summary.goal: Integrate the cultivate package into the server meta-server. Add environment variable configuration (CULTIVATE_DB_PATH, CULTIVATE_SECRET, CULTIVATE_REDIS_URL, CULTIVATE_EXTRACT_MODEL, CULTIVATE_CLUSTER_MODEL). Import createCultivateService from @plannr/cultivate, call initialize(), mount the router at /api/cultivate. Add graceful shutdown integration with the server's existing shutdown handler. Add @plannr/cultivate as a dependency in the server package.json. Update dev.sh to ensure Redis is available.

acceptance_criteria.description: CULTIVATE_DB_PATH, CULTIVATE_SECRET, CULTIVATE_REDIS_URL, CULTIVATE_EXTRACT_MODEL, CULTIVATE_CLUSTER_MODEL env vars are read by server
createCultivateService() imported and initialize() called during server startup
Cultivate router mounted at /api/cultivate
Cultivate shutdown() called during server graceful shutdown
@plannr/cultivate added to server package.json dependencies
dev.sh updated to start Redis before server

steps.title: Add env var configuration
steps.description: Update the server's configuration module to read cultivate-specific environment variables: CULTIVATE_DB_PATH (default: ./cultivate.db), CULTIVATE_SECRET (required for auth encryption, no default), CULTIVATE_REDIS_URL (default: redis://localhost:6379), CULTIVATE_EXTRACT_MODEL (optional, overrides default Sonnet model for extraction), CULTIVATE_CLUSTER_MODEL (optional, overrides default Haiku model for clustering). Add these to the server's config type and validation.

acceptance_criteria.description: All 5 env vars read with correct defaults
CULTIVATE_SECRET has no default (must be provided)
Config type updated to include cultivate settings

steps.title: Import and initialize cultivate service in server
steps.description: In the server's initialization sequence (packages/server/src/server.ts or equivalent), import createCultivateService from @plannr/cultivate. After existing services are initialized (planner, ideation, forge), create the cultivate service with the config from env vars. Call cultivateService.initialize(). Handle CultivateStartupError — log the error and decide whether to abort server startup or continue without cultivate (configurable via CULTIVATE_REQUIRED env var, default false for backward compatibility).

acceptance_criteria.description: Cultivate service created and initialized after existing services
CultivateStartupError handled per CULTIVATE_REQUIRED flag
Server can start without cultivate when CULTIVATE_REQUIRED is false

steps.title: Mount router at /api/cultivate
steps.description: Mount the cultivate Express router at the /api/cultivate path prefix, consistent with other domain mounts (/api/plans, /api/ideation, /api/forge). Ensure the cultivate router is only mounted if initialization succeeded. Place it in the middleware stack alongside other domain routers, before the error handler.

acceptance_criteria.description: Router mounted at /api/cultivate
Only mounted if cultivate initialization succeeded
Positioned correctly in middleware stack (before error handler)

steps.title: Add graceful shutdown integration
steps.description: Integrate cultivate's shutdown() into the server's existing graceful shutdown handler (SIGTERM/SIGINT). Call cultivateService.shutdown() alongside existing service shutdowns. Cultivate shutdown should happen before the HTTP server closes to allow in-flight requests to complete. Log cultivate shutdown progress. Handle errors during cultivate shutdown without blocking other service shutdowns.

acceptance_criteria.description: Cultivate shutdown called on SIGTERM/SIGINT
Shutdown happens before HTTP server close
Shutdown errors logged but don't block other services

steps.title: Add new dependencies to server package.json
steps.description: Add @plannr/cultivate as a workspace dependency in packages/server/package.json. Ensure the TypeScript references in tsconfig.json include the cultivate package for build ordering. Verify the import resolves correctly in the monorepo workspace setup.

acceptance_criteria.description: @plannr/cultivate added to server package.json dependencies
tsconfig.json references updated for build ordering
Import resolves correctly in workspace

steps.title: Update dev.sh for Redis
steps.description: Update scripts/dev.sh to ensure Redis is available before starting the server. Add a Redis check (redis-cli ping) or start Redis if not running. Options: check for existing Redis process, start via brew services or docker, or document Redis as a prerequisite. Add CULTIVATE_REDIS_URL to the .env.example if one exists. Log Redis status during dev startup.

acceptance_criteria.description: dev.sh checks Redis availability before server start
Clear error message if Redis is not available
Redis connection URL documented or in env example
